title: WriteLab, AI Content Generation & SEO Platform
summary: A comprehensive SaaS platform for AI-powered content generation, SEO optimization, and multi-channel publishing with multi-LLM orchestration and Google enterprise integrations.
description:
Project Overview

WriteLab is a comprehensive SaaS platform for AI-powered content generation, SEO optimization, and multi-channel publishing. The platform integrates sophisticated multi-agent AI workflows, Google's enterprise ecosystem, and WordPress publishing capabilities to automate end-to-end content marketing operations.

Unified Research Experience

  • Redesigned research workflow from 4 disconnected tabs requiring 3+ redundant searches into a unified, scrollable interface with parallel API orchestration.
  • Reduced user workflow from 6+ page transitions to a single research view, loading all insights (SERP analysis, keyword research, topic exploration) in one search.
  • Implemented progressive loading strategy: SERP data (~45s), content briefs (~60s), and topic exploration (~120s) load independently without blocking the UI.
  • Competitor analysis: Studied Surfer SEO, Frase.io, ContentShake AI, and Clearscope; designed differentiated UX focusing on research-to-action workflows.

Multi-LLM Orchestration with LangGraph

  • Built context-aware blog generation using LangGraph multi-agent workflows with specialized tool-calling agents.
  • Integrated 4 LLM providers: Anthropic Claude (4.5, 4, 3.5), Google Gemini (2.5, 2.0), DeepSeek (Chat, R1 Reasoner), and Perplexity for research.
  • Implemented RAG system using pgvector for semantic search across website content and knowledge base documents (OpenAI ada-002 embeddings).

Google Enterprise Integration

  • Single OAuth flow connecting 3 Google services: Search Console (keyword performance, content gaps), Analytics 4 (traffic analytics), and Business Profile (multi-location management, review responses).
  • Built data caching layer (7-day TTL) to optimize API usage and reduce latency.

WordPress Publishing Without Plugins

  • Developed plugin-free WordPress integration using built-in Application Passwords (WordPress 5.6+).
  • Features: Draft/live publishing, category/tag management, AI-suggested categorization, SEO metadata (Yoast/Rank Math compatible), scheduled posts.

Architecture & Security

  • Frontend: React 19 with React Router 7, TanStack Query, Zustand, Mantine UI, TipTap editor, CSS Modules design system.
  • Backend: Node.js + Express.js with TypeScript (37 route modules), PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector, Redis 7, MinIO, Sequelize ORM with Zod validation.
  • Security: Session-based auth (Passport.js), CSRF protection, SSRF prevention, rate limiting tiers, Helmet.js security headers, encrypted credential storage.

title: SaaS Email Marketing Platform
summary: A production-ready email marketing platform with multi-tenant architecture, queue-based processing, and real-time analytics built with Next.js 16 and TypeScript.
description:
Project Overview

Marketing Mailer is a production-ready, full-stack SaaS email marketing platform built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and modern cloud technologies. The platform enables users to create, send, and track personalized email campaigns at scale with real-time analytics.

Multi-Tenant Architecture

  • User-provided API key model: Each user brings their own Resend API key for complete tenant isolation.
  • No shared infrastructure: Direct billing relationship with email provider, isolated sending reputation.
  • Encrypted credentials: AES-256 encryption for API keys stored at rest.
  • Per-user domain management: Subdomain enforcement for email deliverability.

Core Features

  • Domain Management: DNS record verification (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), domain ownership validation, Resend domain verification API integration.
  • Email Template System: Dynamic template builder with variable interpolation ({{firstName}}, {{lastName}}), HTML and text content support, real-time preview.
  • Recipient Management: CSV import functionality, list segmentation, suppression list management (bounces, complaints, unsubscribes).
  • Campaign Management: Draft → Scheduled → Sending → Completed workflow with real-time status tracking.

Queue-Based Email Processing

  • BullMQ worker for asynchronous email sending with rate limiting (10 emails/second, configurable).
  • 5 concurrent workers with retry logic and failure handling.
  • Job tracking and monitoring for operational visibility.

Real-Time Analytics

  • TinyBird integration for real-time metrics and event tracking.
  • Event tracking: sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complained.
  • Webhook integration for Resend email events with campaign-level statistics caching.

Technical Stack

  • Frontend/Backend: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4.
  • Database: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM (7 normalized models with proper indexing).
  • Authentication: NextAuth.js v5 with bcrypt password hashing.
  • Infrastructure: Docker Compose, BullMQ + Redis, ~6,000 lines of TypeScript across 43 files.

title: Kiwi Kandy, WooCommerce E-commerce Platform
summary: A complete e-commerce platform selling classic New Zealand confectionery worldwide, with SEO improvements driving 445% increase in clicks and 115% increase in impressions.
description:
Project Overview

A full-scale e-commerce website built from scratch for KiwiKandy, dedicated to selling iconic New Zealand confectionery to customers living overseas. This project demonstrates comprehensive e-commerce development, SEO optimization with measurable results, and international shipping logistics.

SEO Results & Performance

  • Implemented SEO strategy improving average search position from 51 to 12 (39 positions improvement) over 6 months.
  • Achieved 115% increase in impressions and 445% increase in organic clicks through technical SEO, content optimization, and strategic keyword targeting.
  • Ranking for competitive product keywords including 'pineapple lumps', 'whittaker chocolates', and NZ confectionery terms.

E-commerce Features

  • Built complete WooCommerce e-commerce store from scratch with custom product configurations, shopping cart, and secure payment gateway integrations.
  • Google Merchant Center integration for automated product feed generation, enabling product listings across Google Shopping with inventory synchronization.
  • Configured complex international shipping zones and rates to handle global deliveries with accurate cost calculations based on weight and destination.
  • Integrated secure payment gateways including Stripe for safe and reliable transactions with PCI compliance.

Automation & Fulfillment

  • Developed custom shipping and fulfillment automation including label generation, inventory tracking, and customer notification workflows.
  • Custom product configurations for gift boxes and variety packs with dynamic pricing based on selections.
  • Automated order processing with status updates and tracking information delivery.

title: The Phone Mason, Local SEO & Lead Generation
summary: A business website built from scratch achieving page 1 rankings for competitive keywords, generating 920+ organic clicks and 150K+ impressions over 16 months.
description:
Project Overview

A comprehensive business website built from scratch for The Phone Mason, a device repair specialist. The project demonstrates end-to-end web development combined with strategic SEO that delivered measurable results in a competitive local market.

SEO Results & Performance

  • Implemented SEO strategy improving average search position from 28 to 15, achieving page 1 rankings for competitive repair keywords.
  • Achieved page 1 rankings for competitive terms: 'phone repairs' (#10), 'samsung battery replacement' (#10), 'android repair' (#9).
  • Generated 920+ organic clicks and 150K+ impressions over 16 months through technical SEO, content optimization, and local citation building.
  • Strong brand presence with 'the phone mason' ranking #1.7 average position.

Technical Implementation

  • Built complete business website from scratch including service pages, online booking system, and contact forms optimized for local lead generation.
  • Implemented robust local SEO strategy including Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, and location-based keyword targeting.
  • Performed extensive on-page optimization focused on relevant keywords, meta descriptions, header tags, and semantic HTML structure.
  • Deployed on AWS with optimized server configuration for fast loading times and reliable uptime.

Ongoing Management

  • Continuous SEO monitoring and refinement using Google Analytics and Google Search Console for keyword tracking and performance analysis.
  • Managed Google Ads campaigns with optimized landing pages for specific repair services.
  • Ongoing maintenance including security updates, performance optimization, and content freshness.

title: Full-Stack Portfolio & CI/CD Pipeline
summary: A full-stack portfolio website featuring a complete CI/CD pipeline for automated builds and deployments to a cloud server.
description:
Project Overview

This portfolio is a full-stack application built from the ground up to serve as a dynamic showcase of my work. More than just a frontend, it features a complete DevOps pipeline that automates the entire process from a `git push` to a live deployment on a cloud server, demonstrating a holistic approach to modern web development.

Full-Stack Architecture

  • The frontend is a responsive single-page application built with React and Vite, using the Mantine component library for a clean and modern UI.
  • The backend is a lightweight Node.js and Express server that serves the static React files and provides a REST API for dynamic content like project data and skills.

CI/CD & DevOps Pipeline

  • The entire application is containerised using a multi-stage Dockerfile, which builds the frontend and bundles it with the backend into a single, optimised image.
  • A GitHub Actions workflow automatically triggers on every push to the `main` branch.
  • The workflow builds the Docker image, pushes it to Docker Hub, and then securely connects to an AWS Lightsail instance via SSH.
  • On the server, Docker Compose pulls the new image and seamlessly redeploys the container, ensuring zero downtime.

title: WEDO - Social Connection Mobile App
summary: A full-stack, cross-platform mobile application for iOS and Android using serverless AWS architecture to connect people through local events.
description:
Project Overview

A full-stack, cross-platform social connection app built for iOS and Android as part of a university capstone project. 'WeDo' helps users build meaningful connections by creating, discovering, and joining local events and activities.

Key Features

  • Personalised event recommendations powered by user interest profiles and location-based filtering.
  • Advanced event search with robust filtering options (date, location, category, price range).
  • Integrated personal calendar to easily track upcoming activities and manage RSVPs.
  • Full event creation and management functionality for users to host their own activities.
  • Real-time notifications for event updates, new attendees, and messages.

Technical Architecture

  • Cross-platform frontend built with React Native for consistent iOS and Android experience with a single codebase.
  • Scalable backend powered by Node.js and Express.js with RESTful API design.
  • Fully serverless architecture leveraging AWS services: Lambda (compute), API Gateway (routing), DynamoDB (database), S3 (image storage), and Cognito (authentication).
  • Cost-efficient, auto-scaling infrastructure that handles traffic spikes without manual intervention.

title: React To-Do List
summary: A classic to-do list application demonstrating fundamental React concepts like state management and event handling.
description:
Project Overview

A classic to-do list application built as a practical exercise to demonstrate fundamental React skills in state management and component architecture.

Core Functionality

  • Add new tasks to the list with input validation.
  • Mark tasks as complete with visual indicators and strike-through styling.
  • Remove tasks from the list with delete functionality.
  • Persist task state during the session.

Technical Implementation

The application's state is managed efficiently with the useState hook. The UI is structured with reusable components for the input form and individual task items, demonstrating component composition principles.
